Panthera leo

lion

KingdomAnimalia
By Erin Harrington

Geographic Range

African lions ( Panthera leo ) live in most of sub-Saharan Africa except in desert and rainforest habitats.

  • Ethiopian
  • native

Habitat

African lions live in plains or savanna habitat with a large prey base (mostly ungulates) and sufficient cover available.

Asiatic lions live in scrubland and teak forest in the small Gir Forest preserve of India.

Physical Description

Lions are large, muscular cats with a short, tawny coat.

Behavior

Lions are the most social of the cats.

Food Habits

Lions prey mostly on large ungulates.
